verdict.rationale: FireHydrant has built-in AI features (Copilot, summaries, AI-drafted retrospectives), so letting users plug in external MCP servers is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence documents only FireHydrant's own official MCP server, which exposes FireHydrant's API to other agents. That is the server role and does not count toward this client-side story, and nothing shows FireHydrant connecting to or consuming tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
